issues: The DirectoryView configuration passes softRemoveEntry, which FileOperationsConfig does not declare.
DirectoryView destructures handleImportFolder and handleImportFiles from a hook result that does not expose them.
The L10n interface does not declare copiedToast or moveToast.
The Picker onChanged callback narrows string to SearchBarStyle and is not assignable to the declared Picker callback.
A capsule glass-effect shape is widened to string fields instead of the declared Shape literals.
A ref-taking callback is supplied where the composed declared property also requires a zero-argument submit callback.

issueGroups: Symbol effects use unsupported string literals instead of the declared SymbolEffect values.
Capsule shapes omit the required style and several shape/color/gradient values are widened strings rather than declared Color or ShapeStyle values.
setInterval and clearInterval are not Scripting globals in the exported declaration set.
Script is referenced as an ambient global in src/l10n/index.ts even though it must be imported from scripting.
Several font objects omit name or add an undeclared weight property.
The SQLite Configuration value omits the required readonly property.
pipShowOnBackground and pipHideOnForeground are passed to HStack even though they are not HStack properties.
Section combines title and footer, a combination excluded by the declared SectionProps union.
Agent tool Card components require strings while the package's AgentToolCardComponent contract makes strings optional.

issues: Three Agent tool Card components require strings while AgentToolCardComponent makes strings optional.
